briefdescription.para: SEC-01: Valid certificate within chain-depth limit → accepted.
SEC-03: Certificate from unknown/untrusted CA → CERT_UNTRUSTED_CA.
SEC-04: Chain depth exceeds kMaxCertChainDepth → fail-closed.
SEC-05: Key generate → store → retrieve round-trip succeeds.
SEC-07: Key rotation lifecycle — during rotation old key is ROTATING, new key is ACTIVE; retrieval of ROTATING key returns KEY_ROTATION_IN_PROGRESS.
SEC-08: Revoked key retrieval → KEY_REVOKED (never usable for encrypt).
SEC-09: Explicit RBAC deny wins over any ABAC allow.
SEC-10: Missing policy (no matching rule) → POLICY_NOT_FOUND (fail-closed).
SEC-11: RBAC deny short-circuits ABAC (RBAC is evaluated first).
SEC-13: Audit entries written in sequence; sequence numbers are monotonic.
SEC-14: Concurrent writes from multiple threads do not lose entries.
SEC-15: Disk-full condition → AUDIT_WRITE_FAILED returned to caller.
SEC-16: isHardDeny() returns true for all fail-closed error codes in the contract taxonomy.
Phase 4 security module contract-hardening focused tests (SEC-01..SEC-16).

detaileddescription.para: Validates every invariant defined in include/security/security_api_contract.h using deterministic, self-contained fixtures. All external I/O is mocked.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: SEC-01 Valid self-signed cert chain accepted within chain-depth limit. SEC-02 Expired certificate → CERT_EXPIRED returned. SEC-03 Unknown CA (cert signed by untrusted root) → CERT_UNTRUSTED_CA. SEC-04 TLS handshake timeout exceeded → TLS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT (fail-closed).

SEC-05 Key generate → store → retrieve round-trip succeeds. SEC-06 Retrieve non-existent key ID → KEY_NOT_FOUND. SEC-07 Key rotation lifecycle: old key → ROTATING, new key → ACTIVE. SEC-08 Revoked key retrieval → KEY_REVOKED (never returned for encrypt).

SEC-09 Explicit deny rule in RBAC wins over any ABAC allow. SEC-10 Missing policy (no matching rule) → POLICY_NOT_FOUND (fail-closed deny). SEC-11 RBAC evaluated before ABAC: RBAC deny short-circuits ABAC. SEC-12 Policy-engine internal error → ACCESS_DENIED (fail-closed).

SEC-13 Audit entries are written with monotonically increasing sequence numbers. SEC-14 Concurrent audit writes from multiple threads do not lose entries. SEC-15 Simulated disk-full → AUDIT_WRITE_FAILED returned to caller. SEC-16 isHardDeny() returns true for all fail-closed error codes.
